select l.log_id, coalesce(l.item_type, 'product') as item_type, coalesce(l.item_id, l.product_id) as item_id, l.product_id, case coalesce(l.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oe.oe_item_code when 'gift' then gift.gift_code else p.product_code end as item_code, case coalesce(l.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oe.oe_item_name when 'gift' then gift.gift_name else p.product_name end as item_name, p.product_code, p.product_name, l.shop_dept_id, shop_dept.dept_name as shop_dept_name, l.warehouse_id, warehouse_dept.dept_name as warehouse_name, l.batch_no, l.expiry_date, l.serial_no, l.location_code, l.location_name, l.movement_type, l.business_type, l.business_id, l.business_no, l.change_quantity, l.before_quantity, l.after_quantity, l.cost_price, l.cost_amount, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.remark from inv_stock_log l left join inv_product p on p.product_id = l.product_id and p.del_flag = '0' left join inv_oe_item oe on coalesce(l.item_type, 'product') = 'oe' and oe.oe_item_id = coalesce(l.item_id, l.product_id) and oe.del_flag = '0' left join inv_gift_box gift on coalesce(l.item_type, 'product') = 'gift' and gift.gift_id = coalesce(l.item_id, l.product_id) and gift.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = l.shop_dept_id left join sys_dept warehouse_dept on warehouse_dept.dept_id = l.warehouse_id
and coalesce(l.item_type, 'product') = #{itemType} and coalesce(l.item_id, l.product_id) = #{itemId} and l.product_id = #{productId}
and ( p.product_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.product_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or oe.oe_item_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or oe.oe_item_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or gift.gift_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or gift.gift_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or l.batch_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or l.serial_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or l.location_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or l.location_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or l.business_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and l.shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and l.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and l.batch_no = #{batchNo} and l.expiry_date = #{expiryDate} and l.serial_no = #{serialNo} and l.location_code = #{locationCode} and l.location_name like concat('%', #{locationName}, '%')
and l.movement_type in ('purchase_return_out', 'purchase_return')
and l.movement_type in ('sales_return_in', 'sales_return')
and l.movement_type in ('sales_out', 'outbound_out')
and (l.movement_type = 'stock_check_profit' or (l.movement_type = 'check' and l.change_quantity > 0))
and (l.movement_type = 'stock_check_loss' or (l.movement_type = 'check' and l.change_quantity < 0))
and l.movement_type = #{movementType}
and l.business_type = #{businessType} and l.business_id = #{businessId} and l.business_no like concat('%', #{businessNo}, '%') and l.create_time >= #{beginTime} and l.create_time < date_add(#{endTime}, interval 1 day) and l.shop_dept_id in #{deptId}
order by l.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into inv_stock_log ( item_type, item_id, product_id, shop_dept_id, warehouse_id, movement_type, business_type, batch_no, expiry_date, serial_no, location_code, location_name, business_id, business_no, change_quantity, before_quantity, after_quantity, cost_price, cost_amount, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( coalesce(#{itemType}, 'product'), coalesce(#{itemId}, #{productId}), #{productId}, #{shopDeptId}, #{warehouseId}, #{movementType}, #{businessType}, #{batchNo}, #{expiryDate}, #{serialNo}, #{locationCode}, #{locationName}, #{businessId}, #{businessNo}, #{changeQuantity}, #{beforeQuantity}, #{afterQuantity}, #{costPrice}, #{costAmount}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
